pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   D. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.

3. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   D. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.

6. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   C. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   D. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   C. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
